slot1.topic: 可收藏：白鞋鞋邊泛灰前的檢查，送洗前先看三個位置
slot1.instagram_caption:
白鞋鞋邊開始泛灰,送洗前先看這三個位置。

第一個看鞋邊那圈膠條。灰是附著的髒,擦得掉;黃是膠本身氧化,那只能淡化不能回白。

第二個看布面靠鞋頭的地方。兩道洗不掉的灰帶,通常是刷過頭把纖維刷起毛了,越刷越舊。

第三個看鞋帶孔周圍。金屬圈旁邊一圈深色是汗漬,滲進去久了會連布一起染。

三個都是灰的,多半救得回來;鞋邊已經轉黃,就先講清楚只能淡化。

一般運動鞋 $250 起、皮類 $300(水洗價)。台中全區免費到府收送。

Scene: a light counter with a pink cutting mat, white slat-wall panels behind, shelves of fabric-care bottles softly out of focus, everyday laundry-shop clutter at the frame edge. Shot on a phone main camera about 26mm, held at chest height angled 20-35 degrees down, handheld with imperfect framing. Storefront window key light from one side, weak fluorescent ceiling fill, uneven counter brightness, slightly imperfect auto white balance, phone sensor noise in deep shadows only. The shoes rest fully on the mat with a continuous hard contact shadow. No laundry basket, no washing machine, no domestic living room, no shopfront. Not cinematic, not studio lighting, no film grain, no creamy background blur, no waxy surfaces, no readable text, no logo, no watermark, no faces. Featured object in every photo: THE SAME single pair of white low-top leather sneakers with a white rubber midsole, honestly worn - the midsole edge visibly greyed with ingrained grime, two dull grey scuff bands across the toe area of the upper, slightly fuzzed fabric where it has been over-brushed, and a darkened sweat ring around the metal lace eyelets. Laces are off-white and slightly greyed. Keep the same pair, same colour, same marks in all four photos. Composition: both shoes side by side on the mat, three-quarter view, the greyed midsole edge facing camera and filling the lower third.

slot1.video_prompt:
Create one continuous 6-second 9:16 photorealistic Taiwanese laundry inspection-counter shot about 鞋子. Fixed close camera with layered depth: exactly one paired set of unbranded sneakers in the foreground, the right shoe opening angled away from camera, a clean inspection tray in the midground, and one softly glowing practical lamp in the background. One adult hand performs one dominant action only: rotate only the right shoe about thirty degrees until its opening and heel lining face the camera; the left shoe remains stationary. Preserve exactly two shoes with complete laces, tongues, soles and heel geometry, five fingers, realistic weight and contact shadows. No cleaning transformation, no extra hands, no duplicate object, no morphing, no penetration, no readable text, no logo, no watermark. End on the revealed detail and hold for one second.

Item profile 2026-08-05-v1: 鞋子類：以鞋口內裡、鞋舌、鞋墊邊或鞋底邊為唯一焦點；只旋轉一隻鞋或抬起一個鞋舌，另一隻鞋、鞋帶、鞋底與膠合縫保持不動，不呈現清潔結果。

video_candidate.conflict: 右腳鞋口仍朝側面，內裡與後跟位置第一眼看不完整。
video_candidate.single_action: 同一隻成人手只把右腳鞋旋轉約三十度，讓鞋口與後跟內裡朝向鏡頭；左腳鞋全程不動。
video_candidate.payoff: 先看材質、位置與原始狀態，再決定怎麼處理。
video_candidate.cta: 拍全貌、局部與洗標，點個人檔案連結加 LINE 先詢問。
video_candidate.first_frame_direction: 固定直式微距中近景；完整鞋子位於乾淨檢查台前景，檢查燈與收納托盤形成中後景層次；只有一隻手停在既有可動位置，物件數量、材質、縫線與接觸陰影清楚，無文字。
